evidence: Matches 'Wallet' label and modifies core wallet key management in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp.
rationale: Refactoring DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan's mutex to be non-recursive improves thread-safety analysis and prevents re-entrancy deadlock hazards. The PR advances the long-standing tracking issue #19303 to remove RecursiveMutex, but addresses internal locking architecture rather than an urgent fund-safety issue or active user-reported bug.
